en: Welcome to Levincia Gym! Iono's gym test is live on her stream: find her Wattrel hiding about the city.
Three of them, tucked away in the streets and on the sea wall. Find them all and Iono will battle you on camera!
Congratulations on the Electric Badge! You were trending for a whole hour.
Iono's Electric types are no match for a good ground move. Watch out for her Mismagius, though.
You beat Iono! The stream's chat still can't stop talking about it.
